purpose: Close the last gate of the halo line: test whether any field-shaped co-variation around pathologist TLS survives conditioning on per-spot cell composition (the C6 covariates), in addition to the detection-field level and tissue trend.

nnls_attempt.source: frozen R-04 composition reference, infra/r04/composition_ref (GSE236581 CRC-ICB, 6 classes incl. ILC)
nnls_attempt.status: EXECUTED BUT INVALID OUT OF DOMAIN
nnls_attempt.evidence: on the labelled sections the per-spot NNLS degenerates: usz-LC3 mean proportions T=0.00 B=0.63 Mye=0.00 ILC=0.00 Epi=0.00 Stromal=0.37; gse175540-...c_2 T=0.01 B=0.11 Mye=0.24 ILC=0.00 Epi=0.06 Stromal=0.57. The reference is colorectal; the labelled cohorts are kidney/lung (USZ) and ccRCC (GSE175540), so epithelial/immune class profiles do not transfer. Profile recovery on the reference itself is exact (each true profile recovers itself 1.0), so the failure is domain mismatch, not a code bug. Results of this arm are archived as v9.0 and support no conclusion.
nnls_attempt.v9_0_note: own arm 7.1% of 968 section-tests at p<=0.05 vs comp arm 7.2%, no readout passing; reported only as an invalid-control trace

v9_1_marker_proxy.source: infra/r04/marker_proxy_combined.json (CellMarker 2.0 + PanglaoDB + CellTypist CRC voted markers) plus r16.axes.PLASMA_GENES
covariates: T (111 genes in the analysed sections)

excluded.B: it is the anchor-adjacent axis and is already represented by the detection-signature deciles
excluded.ILC: non-viable in the frozen proxy (1 gene in panel)

v9_1_marker_proxy.validity_check: modules behave as expected: T up in TLS (0.033 vs 0.024 LC3; 0.054 vs 0.035 GSE), B up in TLS, Plasma up in TLS on GSE (0.451 vs 0.262), Epi down in TLS and up in tumour (0.024 vs 0.016 LC3), Stromal up in tumour
v9_1_marker_proxy.form: per-spot module score (identical AUCell operator), converted to deciles and used as covariates

design.anchors: pathologist TLS labels (USZ ground_truth == TLS; GSE175540 == TLS), same 26 sections
design.statistic: identical to v8.1/v8.2: section-level edge distance bins, contrast = mean(bin 200-300) - mean(bin 700-800), >=30 spots per bin, ring 1.3*pitch excluded

arms.own: conditioning = [deciles of own detection score] + quadratic trend (v8.2 comparator, recomputed here)
arms.comp: primary: conditioning = [deciles of own detection score] + [deciles of each composition covariate] + quadratic trend (covariates per the v9.1 marker-proxy definition)

design.null: identical to v8.2: matched-sigma smooth surrogate of the conditioned residual with a white-noise fallback when sigma cannot be fitted; 200 draws; same TLS mask
design.claim_rule: unchanged: >=50% of evaluable sections with p <= 0.05, >=8 sections, median observed > median null
design.interpretation_rule: if the comp arm loses the own arm's signal, the residual excess is attributable to composition; if both are null there is no field-shaped co-variation beyond composition and detection level; a comp-arm claim still requires the external-anchor caveat (labels are pathology TLS, not molecular ground truth)
